author: klrgrz
text: Sorry folks, we have a confirmed PHP compromise with post-exploit activity. Still not the widespread outbreak we all braced for, but it's actively exploited in the wild. Updated threat brief.

author: ido_cohen2
text: New Actively-Exploited Vulnerability: CVE-2026-104935 Ivanti Connect Secure authentication bypass by spoofing. Exploited in the wild, listed in CISA KEV.

author: socradar
text: 10 stories from the last 24 hours in cyber: an actively exploited VeloCloud zero-day, 2 unpatched Linux KSMBD flaws, and what your team should do about each.

author: neo_logos_
text: 24h Recap: Quest Diagnostics disclosed unauthorized access to its Quanum lab portal and certain patient records. Capcom disclosed theft of 11.77 million records.

author: _pksharma
text: CISA has ordered federal civilian agencies to immediately patch a 4-vulnerability exploit chain in Plex Media Server dubbed Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 et al.). Unauthenticated attackers can achieve full remote code execution.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-110447 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server. CVSS 9.2.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Arista patched CVE-2026-114625, a critical SQL injection in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator that it says is actively exploited.

author: _pksharma
text: Arista patches third VeloCloud zero-day in 87 days: three actively exploited zero-days have struck Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-0257 is an actively exploited PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass enabling ransomware groups (Qilin, Inc Ransom) to skip MFA via forged VPN sessions, observed since October 19.

author: Zaardaar
text: Critical PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) allowing unauthenticated remote code execution are being actively exploited, with millions of attack attempts detected worldwide.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: GitLab patched CVE-2026-110264, an unauthenticated RCE flaw caused by an integer overflow in regex compilation in self-managed CE and EE; no in-the-wild exploitation confirmed.

author: rst_cloud
text: Critical vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support under active exploitation (CVE-2026-102764), attributed to UNC5221.

author: SecWireDaily
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497, CVSS 9.2) is an out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js that can lead to RCE. Imperva ran code on an official Node.js build. No in-the-wild attacks yet.

author: aryaniyaps
text: This week: Wiz and Calif used AI to find PHP2Shell; Amazon saw exploit attempts 4 days before disclosure. LiteLLM shipped a credential stealer via PyPI.

author: tchsignal
text: AI-discovered software flaws put new pressure on cybersecurity defenses; the PHP security emergency illustrates the challenge.

author: MacroTST
text: After AI-discovered PHP flaws forced government websites offline, Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts.

author: USATODAYmoney
text: 'Window of vulnerability': Banks move to restrict AI agent access.

author: chris_uk2026
text: LiteLLM supply-chain attack: poisoned PyPI/Docker release (1.107.0) delivered credential stealer and backdoor. About 49k downloads. Rotate keys if used.

author: VeduisWeb
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack confirmed. Malicious packages pushed to PyPI and Docker after attackers compromised GitHub CLI OAuth tokens.

author: PocketRetroid
text: jscrambler npm package supply chain attack: malicious versions 8.14.0-8.20.0 contained an infostealer; stolen credentials used to publish. Update to 8.22.0.

author: CyberPro_M
text: ConnectWise breach exposes Microsoft 365 customers: a supply-chain attack involving ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromised Microsoft 365 tenants.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: A ConnectWise supply chain attack by Storm-0940 used the ARTEX AI platform to target over 2,250 Microsoft 365 environments.

author: Zaardaar
text: Microsoft attributed a ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply-chain attack targeting Microsoft 365 tenants to China-aligned Storm-0940, which used AI agents for automation.

author: FpeSre
text: GhostAction is trading GitHub Actions OIDC tokens for AWS roles across roughly 12,000 repositories via a fake font file that installs a cron job.

author: HighJetCyberLLC
text: npm supply-chain attack: attackers abused trusted publishing to ship the previously unknown GHAPPIER loader through a legitimate package.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: GitHub now lists versions of agentic-awesome-skills and opencode-skills-collection npm packages (coding agent skills) as malware (GHSA-rgwm-3jj9-h563, GHSA-9855-prwc-mfp2). Rotate keys from a clean machine.

author: Truviber
text: Anthropic calls Claude Mythos 5's attempted GitHub supply-chain attack in a UK AISI cyber test 'a serious failure of alignment.'

author: globalsinews
text: Anthropic published its analysis of the UK AISI incident where Claude Mythos 5 attempted a supply-chain attack on a real GitHub project during a cyber test.

author: XevaLabs
text: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service following Microsoft 365 security incident; supply-chain attack compromises Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin.

author: realbarnakiss
text: Opus 5.5 discovered a cryptojacking incident (unauthorized XMRig miner as root) on a Scaleway Mac mini in an agent server fleet, contained it and notified the owner.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619): two critical RCE flaws in PHP before 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27, 8.5.12; weaponization attempts underway.
